bibManager.title: Bib Manager
bibManager.noProjectDesc: Open a project in the workspace first to use Bib Manager
bibManager.step1Desc: Enter a reference example, LLM will identify its format rules and required fields
bibManager.step1Placeholder: e.g.: Vaswani, Ashish et al. Attention Is All You Need[J]. arXiv preprint arXiv:1706.03762, 2017.
bibManager.lowConfidenceHint: Try a clearer example or check the result
bibManager.customStyleHint: No built-in LaTeX style for this format. Click “Edit format” to fill in backend, package, and preamble settings, then save for later use.
bibManager.latexStyleFieldsHint: Leave blank to skip a style recommendation; fill in to save a custom style.
bibManager.step2Desc: Enter reference metadata text or upload a screenshot containing reference information
bibManager.step2Placeholder: Paste reference info from Google Scholar, CNKI, or other sources...
bibManager.step2NoInput: Please enter text or upload an image
bibManager.doiLookupDesc: Enter a DOI to automatically fetch metadata
bibManager.step3Desc: Generate standard BibTeX code based on extracted metadata
bibManager.step4Desc: Select a .bib file in the project to write or update the generated entry
bibManager.step4NoBibFiles: No .bib files found in the project. Copy the BibTeX code and add it manually.
bibManager.step5Desc: Generate LaTeX code snippet with correct \bibliographystyle and \bibliography commands
bibManager.step5Hint: Add the above code to your LaTeX document. Preamble configuration is included; place the reference list command at the end of the document.

library.title: Bibliography Library

writingChat.title: Writing Assistant
writingChat.noSessions: No sessions yet, click + to create
writingChat.assistantHint1: 1. When "All paragraphs" is selected, the entire file (up to 12 paragraphs) is used as context.
writingChat.assistantHint4: 2. When "No context" is selected, the LLM will not receive file content and will reply based on conversation history only.
writingChat.assistantHint2: 3. Select a paragraph and click below the assistant's reply
writingChat.emptySessionHint: Click the + button on the left to create a new session
writingChat.inputPlaceholder: Ask the assistant, Shift+Enter for new line
writingChat.compressedHint: Session compressed — delete to restore original messages
writingChat.toolConfirmEditDesc: The LLM wants to edit paragraph {{index}} in {{file}}. Allow?
writingChat.toolConfirmUndoDesc: The LLM wants to undo the last edit to {{file}}. Allow?
writingChat.citationWarning: The following citation links were not found in this search. Please verify the sources:
writingChat.captchaDesc: Search engine {{engine}} triggered verification. Complete the following to continue.

workspace.noParagraphs: No paragraphs found or file is empty

workspace.closeConfirmDesc: Closing will clear all loaded paragraphs and check results. You'll need to reopen next time.
workspace.undoConfirmDesc: Revert this file to its state before the last change. Can be redone after undoing.

styleModify.title: LaTeX Style Modifier
styleModify.noProjectDesc: Open a project in the workspace first so the Agent can locate and modify style definitions
styleModify.agentRequirementPlaceholder: e.g., make section headings the theme blue and reduce caption font size
styleModify.agentTimelineEmpty: Project browsing, search, candidate changes, and compilation will appear here
styleModify.refinePlaceholder: e.g., use a lighter blue and update the header to match
styleModify.traceEmpty: No trace yet. Run once to record it.
styleModify.sourcePlaceholder: Paste the LaTeX code to modify
styleModify.requirementPlaceholder: Describe the style changes you want in natural language
styleModify.requirementExamples: e.g., center-align the first column of the table, bold the Name column, place two images side by side, move the table to page top

templateGen.title: Template Gen
templateGen.descPlaceholder: Describe the LaTeX template type you need (e.g., IEEE conference paper, English resume, academic report)
templateGen.descDetailPlaceholder: e.g., A paper template for CVPR submission, including abstract, introduction, methods, experiments, conclusion...
templateGen.agentHint: Autonomous Agent plans a multi-file project, writes files, and compile-verifies until a compilable LaTeX project is produced.
templateGen.timelineEmpty: Click "Autonomous Generate" to start. The Agent will plan, write files, and compile-verify.
templateGen.traceDesc: Records the full interaction of each Agent run (prompts, tool calls, execution results) for analysis and improvement
templateGen.traceEmpty: No trace yet. Run a generation to record one.

plotGen.title: Scientific Plot
plotGen.subtitle: Upload CSV/Excel/JSON data and generate reproducible PDF/SVG/TikZ vector figures
plotGen.descPlaceholder: e.g., compare changes across three groups over time, show means, error bars, and significance
plotGen.timelineEmpty: After uploading data, the Agent will plan the chart, write scripts, execute, and compile TikZ
plotGen.refinePlaceholder: e.g., move the legend to the upper left, use log Y-axis, change group A to dark blue
plotGen.traceDesc: Records the full interaction of each Agent run (prompts, tool calls, execution results) for analysis and improvement
plotGen.traceEmpty: No trace yet. Run a generation or refinement to record one.
